<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="תמוז_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518919103_theRebbe_196" batchId="meluket-_D7_AA_D7_9E_D7_95_D7_96_meluket__BH_POST_1766518919103_theRebbe_196__p005">
  <section v="12">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains the connection between the verse "Hashem Nafshenu Bachayim" and the liberation of 12 Tammuz through the interplay of nature and miracles, rooted in Chesed and Gevurah, and culminating in the inclusion of left in right.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">9)</t>
    <t s="1">And it can be said that this is the connection of "Hashem Nafshenu Bachayim" etc. with the liberation of 12 Tammuz,</t>
    <t s="2">for it is known50</t>
    <t s="3">that through the conduct of nature,</t>
    <t s="4">which is always in one manner,</t>
    <t s="5">the concept of "I have not changed"51 is revealed</t>
    <t s="6">(except that the concept of "I have not changed" as it is revealed in the natural conduct is clothed in the limitation of nature),</t>
    <t s="7">and through miracles, the revelation of the boundless light of Ein Sof, which is above clothing in worlds, is drawn down.</t>
    <t s="8">And the root of these two matters is Chesed and Gevurah.</t>
    <t s="9">For the conduct of nature</t>
    <t s="10">(contraction and limitation)</t>
    <t s="11">is from Gevurah</t>
    <t s="12">[And it can be said that this, that specifically in the natural conduct the concept of "I have not changed" is revealed, is because the root of Gevurah is higher than the root of Chesed],</t>
    <t s="13">and miracles</t>
    <t s="14">(a revelation above the limitation of nature)</t>
    <t s="15">are from Chesed.</t>
    <t s="16">And the matter of including the left in the right is,</t>
    <t s="17">that the revelation of the boundless light of Ein Sof through miracles is not in a manner of overturning nature,</t>
    <t s="18">but rather, even though nature remains in its existence,</t>
    <t s="19">one sees in revelation that it is a miracle above nature.</t>
    <t s="20">And perhaps it can be said,</t>
    <t s="21">that what is stated in Tanya52</t>
    <t s="22">that the matter of "He joined with it the attribute of mercy"53</t>
    <t s="23">is the revelation of G-dliness through tzaddikim and signs and wonders,</t>
    <t s="24">the intention in this is</t>
    <t s="25">(primarily)</t>
    <t s="26">for the signs and wonders</t>
    <t s="27">[that are through the tzaddikim]</t>
    <t s="28">that are clothed in nature</t>
    <t s="29">("He joined with it"),</t>
    <t s="30">that the signs and wonders that are above nature are from Chesed,</t>
    <t s="31">and nature</t>
    <t s="32">(in which the wonders are clothed)</t>
    <t s="33">is from Gevurah,</t>
    <t s="34">and therefore these signs and wonders are from the attribute of mercy,</t>
    <t s="35">Tiferet,</t>
    <t s="36">which connects the two opposites of Chesed and Gevurah.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="13">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the liberation of 12 Tammuz was an open miracle above nature that did not nullify nature, thereby including left in right and empowering every Jew to sanctify mundane matters as preparation for the ultimate revelation of G-dliness.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And this is the connection of "Hashem Nafshenu Bachayim" etc. to the liberation of 12 Tammuz,</t>
    <t s="1">for the liberation of 12 Tammuz</t>
    <t s="2">(including also the beginning of the liberation that was on 3 Tammuz)</t>
    <t s="3">was an open miracle above nature,</t>
    <t s="4">and nevertheless it was not in a manner of overturning and nullifying nature,</t>
    <t s="5">but rather nature remained in its existence,</t>
    <t s="6">and moreover, even the opponents remained then in their strength,</t>
    <t s="7">and nevertheless they were compelled to assist</t>
    <t s="8">(and through their very strength)</t>
    <t s="9">in the release and liberation54.</t>
    <t s="10">And through this, the barrier between the lower ones and the upper ones was nullified,</t>
    <t s="11">to include left in right.</t>
    <t s="12">And through this, power was subsequently given to every Jew to nullify the barrier between involvement in mundane matters and the fulfillment of Torah and mitzvot,</t>
    <t s="13">so that even in mundane matters, the light of Torah and mitzvot will shine,</t>
    <t s="14">and this becomes a close preparation for the fulfillment of the prophecy55</t>
    <t s="15">"And the glory of the L-rd shall be revealed, and all flesh together shall see that the mouth of the L-rd has spoken,"</t>
    <t s="16">that even physical flesh will see G-dliness56.</t>
    <t s="17">And all this is accomplished through the signs and wonders that are through the tzaddikim,</t>
    <t s="18">who draw down into nature a revelation of G-dliness that is above nature,</t>
    <t s="19">as it was in those days at this time.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
